MlxTargets.TargetFields: arch os abi endian pointer_bits cpu_features
MlxTargets.BuiltinModule: target, cpu features, optimize mode, language version

Target.note: the default is the system the compiler runs on: a compiler built for brixOS builds brixOS programs without --target

Target.output: static ELF executable for brixOS; std picks its X.brixos.mlx files (for std.X and relative imports), reads and writes by brixOS's own calls, and _start ends by process_exit
static ELF without an operating system (a kernel)
ELF shared object for the output path ending in .so, signed APK for .apk

MlxTargets.Rule: A function requiring a CPU feature may only be called when the compilation target guarantees the feature or from code guarded by an explicit runtime dispatch mechanism that targets a feature-specialized function.
